### 🐛 Describe the bug I am trying to run `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8` with prefix caching and `MooncakeStoreConnector`. According to the official recipe, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next should support Mooncake distributed KV store: https://recipes.vllm.ai/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next?hardware=h200&kv_offload=kv_store_distributed_mooncake&variant=fp8&features=tool_calling%2Creasoning%2Cspec_decoding What I see is a staged failure: 1. Without `--kv-transfer-config`, the model starts successfully. 2. After enabling `--kv-transfer-config`, startup fails with: `RuntimeError: Worker failed with error 'block_size must be divisible by hash_block_size'` 3. After adding `--prefix-match-unit 8` to address that error, startup fails again with: `ValueError: MooncakeStoreConnector does not support: ... (mamba_cache_mode != 'align')` ### Mooncake config ```json { "mode": "embedded", "metadata_server": "http://xxxx:8080/metadata", "master_server_address": "xxxx:50051", "global_segment_size": "100GB", "local_buffer_size": "4GB", "protocol": "rdma", "device_name": "" } ``` ## Reproduction ### Step 1: baseline works without Mooncake KV transfer The model can start normally if `--kv-transfer-config` is not set. Command: ```bash SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU=1 \ PYTHONHASHSEED=0 \ VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 \ NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 \ NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=bond4 \ VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/api-models-h20/Qwen/cached \ vllm serve /api-models-h20/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \ --trust-remote-code \ --served-model-name Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \ --enable-prefix-caching \ --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \ --enable-expert-parallel \ --tensor-parallel-size 4 \ --moe-backend triton \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \ --max-model-len auto \ --enable-auto-tool-choice \ --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \ --reasoning-parser qwen3 \ --enable-request-id-headers \ --enable-prompt-tokens-details \ --max-num-seqs 256 \ --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' ``` ### Step 2: enabling Mooncake KV transfer hits hash block size failure Command: ```bash MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH=/api-models-h20/Qwen/mooncake_config/config \ SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU=1 \ PYTHONHASHSEED=0 \ VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 \ NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 \ NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=bond4 \ VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/api-models-h20/Qwen/cached \ vllm serve /api-models-h20/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \ --trust-remote-code \ --served-model-name Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \ --enable-prefix-caching \ --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \ --enable-expert-parallel \ --tensor-parallel-size 4 \ --moe-backend triton \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \ --max-model-len auto \ --enable-auto-tool-choice \ --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \ --reasoning-parser qwen3 \ --enable-request-id-headers \ --enable-prompt-tokens-details \ --max-num-seqs 256 \ --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' \ --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both"}' ``` After enabling `--kv-transfer-config`, startup fails with: ```text RuntimeError: Worker failed with error 'block_size must be divisible by hash_block_size', please check the stack trace above for the root cause ``` The original worker-side error does not print the concrete block sizes. In a locally instrumented build, I added extra logging and got the following details: ```text AssertionError: block_size must be divisible by hash_block_size. block_sizes=[800, 8, 800, 800, 800, 800], hash_block_size=800' ``` ### Step 3: adding `--prefix-match-unit 8` hits MooncakeStoreConnector validation failure Command: ```bash MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH=/api-models-h20/Qwen/mooncake_config/config \ SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU=1 \ PYTHONHASHSEED=0 \ VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 \ NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 \ NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=bond4 \ VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/api-models-h20/Qwen/cached \ vllm serve /api-models-h20/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 \ --trust-remote-code \ --served-model-name Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-KV \ --enable-prefix-caching \ --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \ --enable-expert-parallel \ --tensor-parallel-size 4 \ --moe-backend triton \ --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \ --max-model-len auto \ --enable-auto-tool-choice \ --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml \ --reasoning-parser qwen3 \ --enable-request-id-headers \ --enable-prompt-tokens-details \ --max-num-seqs 256 \ --prefix-match-unit 8 \ --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' \ --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both"}' ``` ```text ValueError: MooncakeStoreConnector does not support: group 2: MambaSpec with block_size=800 != cache_config.block_size=8 (mamba_cache_mode != 'align'); group 3: MambaSpec with block_size=800 != cache_config.block_size=8 (mamba_cache_mode != 'align'); group 4: MambaSpec with block_size=800 != cache_config.block_size=8 (mamba_cache_mode != 'align'); group 5: MambaSpec with block_size=800 != cache_config.block_size=8 (mamba_cache_mode != 'align') ``` ### Before submitting a new issue... - [x] Make sure you already searched for relevant issues, and asked the chatbot living at the bottom right corner of the [documentation page](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/), which can answer lots of frequently asked questions.
